environment.description: Same EC2 instance and application WAR, but fronted by an internal ALB (scheme=internal) with a CloudFront distribution as the only public entry point. The CloudFront distribution has a custom origin request policy that strips query parameters matching regex patterns containing '${}' sequences and '%24%7B' (URL-encoded variants) via a CloudFront Function (viewer-request event) that returns 403 for any request where the decoded URI + query string contains the byte sequence 0x24 0x7B (dollar-brace). Additionally, the Tomcat instance has a Valve configured (org.apache.catalina.valves.RemoteAddrValve) allowing only the ALB's VPC CIDR range (10.0.0.0/16), and the EC2 security group restricts inbound to the ALB's security group only. The CloudFront Function uses a character-level scan that decodes up to 3 levels of URL encoding before matching, covering double and triple encoding bypass attempts.
